sourcePriority: direct appearance in card text and authored card scenes
defaultState: Baseline appearances; event-only transformations are excluded.
style: minimal flat shapes with one crisp white catchlight inside every visible pupil

characters.name: Lyra Vaneshade
characters.appearance: Pale, long straight crimson hair, a narrow face and sharply arched brows; a neat crimson shoulder cape over academy navy. Proud, exacting noble pyromancer.
characters.canon: Crimson hair and tall stature are explicit; hair colour overrides the black SVG.
characters.design: Long loose hair and pale skin follow the SVG; the sharp face and cape express noble precision.

characters.name: Tobias Fennick
characters.appearance: Pale, short ginger crop, a broad square face and very broad shoulders; a worn green collar over plain academy clothes. Gentle farm boy with an open, slightly sheepish smile.
characters.canon: Big, broad-shouldered farm boy; worldbook says built like a barn door.
characters.design: Ginger crop and pale skin follow the SVG; the square face and work-worn green collar are design choices.

characters.name: Seraphine Hale
characters.appearance: Pale, slight face; loose ivory hair framing the cheeks, silver-grey irises around dark highlighted pupils, and a dark blue scarf with a few large stars. Dreamy, perceptive seer.
characters.canon: Silver-grey eyes and star scarf are explicit in her introductory card scene; pale fingers in the tarot scene take precedence over the darker SVG skin.
characters.design: Ivory hair and loose cheek-length shape follow the SVG; the narrow face is a design choice. Normal portrait, without a trance.

characters.name: Corvin Ashby
characters.appearance: Warm tan, dark brown hair swept into a small high knot, a lean angular face and crooked grin; an open navy collar and charcoal scarf. Charming, reckless passage-finder.
characters.canon: A grinning dark-haired student; he lends the player his scarf.
characters.design: Dark brown hair, topknot and tan skin follow the SVG; the narrow face and untidy open collar are design choices.

characters.name: Mir Ten
characters.appearance: Copper-brown skin, wild brick-red hair, brass goggles pushed above the forehead, a round face and an eager grin; teal apron straps over academy navy, one soot smudge. Curious clockworks inventor.
characters.canon: Goggles, wild hair and soot are explicit.
characters.design: Brick-red hair and copper-brown skin follow the SVG; round cheeks and teal workwear distinguish their inventive enthusiasm.

characters.name: Nessa Quill
characters.appearance: Deep brown skin, dark hair in a large high bun with a short side fringe, a heart-shaped face and keen raised brows; ochre lapels and a small ink mark on her nose. Bold, overworked student editor.
characters.canon: Ink on her nose is explicit after the Ledger deadline.
characters.design: Dark brown hair, bun and deep brown skin follow the SVG; the heart-shaped face, fringe and ochre lapels are design choices.

characters.name: Bram Hollis
characters.appearance: Warm tan, a clipped blond crop, a broad square jaw and heavy angled brows; a red prefect sash across a stiff navy collar. Officious and insecure behind a tight, self-important mouth.
characters.canon: Burly prefect and red sash are explicit.
characters.design: Blond cropped hair and tan skin follow the SVG; the square jaw and rigid collar are design choices.

characters.name: Kael Dumont
characters.appearance: Pale, short ivory hair with an angular fringe, a long narrow face and restrained blue-grey eyes with dark highlighted pupils; dark slate fur-lined collar, a little frost at the lashes. Guarded Northern transfer.
characters.canon: Pale, fur-lined coat and frost in his eyelashes are explicit; Ilse shares his eyes.
characters.design: Short ivory hair follows the SVG; the angular fringe, narrow face and blue-grey iris colour are design choices shared with Ilse.

characters.name: Ilse Dumont
characters.appearance: Pale, long straight ivory hair, a small pointed face and the same blue-grey eyes as Kael, with dark highlighted pupils; a high collar of white fur. Fierce, wary Northern outsider.
characters.canon: White furs, pale siblings and eyes recognisably like Kael’s are explicit.
characters.design: Long ivory hair and pale skin follow the SVG; the pointed face and shared iris colour are design choices.

characters.name: Tamsin Reed
characters.appearance: Warm brown skin, short choppy golden hair, a slim triangular face, prominent ears and a sly asymmetric smile; a green Thornwick collar. Curious illusionist raised around travelling theatre.
characters.canon: Thornwick students wear green robes; no stable personal appearance is specified in their cards.
characters.design: Golden cropped hair and brown skin follow the SVG; ears, face shape and smile distinguish their theatrical wit.

characters.name: Headmistress Isolde Marrow
characters.appearance: Pale, long straight black hair with faint grey temples, a long oval face, thin oval spectacles and a high plum collar. A calm, watchful headmistress whose slight smile carries authority.
characters.canon: Tall and pale; dark robes and spectacles are explicit. Newly white hair belongs to a later outcome, not this default portrait.
characters.design: Long black hair and pale skin follow the SVG; faint greying, long face and structured plum collar are design choices.

characters.name: Professor Aldric Thorne
characters.appearance: Pale, short swept-back grey hair, a pointed grey beard, a long jaw scar and severe brows; a high charcoal collar edged in muted indigo. Exacting elderly arcana teacher with watchful, humane eyes.
characters.canon: Grey beard, elderly appearance and long jaw scar are explicit in card scenes.
characters.design: Pale skin and short light hair follow the SVG; beard shape and high collar are design choices.

characters.name: Old Maud
characters.appearance: Warm brown, wispy ivory hair in an untidy cheek-length halo, small round spectacles and a deeply lined round face; a frayed moss-green shawl. Kindly, sharp-eyed eighty-one-year-old hedge-witch.
characters.canon: Spectacles, shawl and age eighty-one are explicit.
characters.design: Ivory loose hair and warm brown skin follow the SVG; the wispy silhouette, deep face lines and worn green shawl distinguish the groundskeeper.

characters.name: Sister Amaranth
characters.appearance: Dark warm brown, close-cropped copper hair, narrow rectangular spectacles and a firm rectangular face; a starched white apron over claret clothing. Severe, dependable middle-aged healer with a small reassuring smile.
characters.canon: Spectacles and white/starched apron are explicit.
characters.design: Copper cropped hair and brown skin follow the SVG; spectacle shape, rectangular face and claret underlayer are design choices.

characters.name: Professor Hedda Brask
characters.appearance: Deep brown weathered skin, a shaggy grey crop, broad cheekbones and heavy straight brows; a thick leather apron collar over earth-coloured clothing. Dry, brave older beastcraft professor.
characters.canon: Grey hair, weathered appearance and leather apron are explicit; grey overrides the blond SVG.
characters.design: Deep brown skin and the shaggy hair silhouette follow the SVG; broad cheekbones and straight brows are design choices.

characters.name: Professor Ottilie Vey
characters.appearance: Warm tan, long blue-black hair framing a tapered face, one elegantly lifted brow and an amused smile; a violet coat and broad violet scarf. Sly, theatrical middle-aged illusion teacher.
characters.canon: Violet coat and scarf are explicit.
characters.design: Blue-black long hair and tan skin follow the SVG; the tapered face and lifted brow are design choices.

characters.name: Professor Ines Marisol
characters.appearance: Warm dark brown, tousled chestnut hair around a soft oval face, a floppy blue rain hat tipped back clear of her eyes, and a lake-blue collar. Warm, weather-loving tidecaller with a delighted smile.
characters.canon: Soaked hat and wind-tossed hair are explicit.
characters.design: Brown loose hair and dark warm skin follow the SVG; blue hat, rounded face and blue collar are design choices.

characters.name: Mabel Thistlewood
characters.appearance: Copper-brown, a neat rounded ivory bob with curved fringe, full cheeks and warm smile lines; a cream apron with broad ochre shoulders. Brisk, perceptive village tea-shop keeper.
characters.canon: Older village tea-shop keeper; no stable hair or skin description in her cards.
characters.design: Ivory cheek-length hair and copper-brown skin follow the SVG; a smooth rounded bob, full cheeks and ochre apron outfit are design choices.

characters.name: Mr Alder Grimsby
characters.appearance: Warm tan, a full short cap of ivory hair, feathery white eyebrows, a rounded long-nosed face and an absent-minded smile; a rust-brown coat over a soft cream collar. Courteous, eccentric elderly bookseller.
characters.canon: Elderly bookseller, enthusiastic and vague; no stable face details in his cards.
characters.design: Short ivory hair and tan skin follow the SVG; eyebrows, face shape and rust-brown shop coat are design choices.

characters.name: Old Pell
characters.appearance: Copper-brown, closely trimmed ivory hair, narrow spectacles, a long creased face and a small straight white moustache; a bottle-green high collar and plain apron. Proud, exacting elderly village apothecary.
characters.canon: Old apothecary with spectacles is explicit.
characters.design: Short ivory hair and copper-brown skin follow the SVG; narrow frames, long face, small moustache and green collar are design choices.

characters.name: Grisk
characters.appearance: Olive-green goblin, long pointed ears, a hooked nose, short dark-olive scalp tuft and a courteous toothy grin; clear pince-nez and a plum velvet waistcoat. Patient, calculating village moneylender.
characters.canon: Goblin, velvet waistcoat and pince-nez are explicit; pince-nez overrides the SVG monocle.
characters.design: Olive skin, long ears, nose, scalp tuft and toothy grin follow the goblin SVG; clear lens styling keeps highlighted pupils visible.
